focus: Event Counts and conservative correction status
full_notice_credit_rule: Read entire substantive primary publisher notice, verify its correction DOI and original DOI relationship, record source-located summary; no credit for search snippets/metadata
ownership_rule: SHA256(normalized bare notice DOI), unsigned big endian modulo 10; 'doi:' prefix is NOT hashed (consistent with shard02/05).
population_of_search: Open-access 2025-2026 biomedical publisher notices discovered in targeted web search; convenience development data, not systematic or validation sample

records.notice_title: Correction: Standard versus double dosing of beta-lactam antibiotics in critically ill patients with sepsis: The BULLSEYE study protocol for a multicenter randomized controlled trial
records.notice_body_locator: Correction body immediately after original article reference, web displayed lines 56-67
records.original_title: Standard versus double dosing of beta-lactam antibiotics in critically ill patients with sepsis: The BULLSEYE study protocol for a multicenter randomized controlled trial
records.study_design: randomized multicenter open-label trial protocol, not results
records.change_locator: Abstract > Methods antibiotic list, ninth drug
records.primary_source_evidence: Notice 2025-04-07 says its abstract Methods list previously contained wrong ninth drug and original article was corrected; notice publisher page web lines 58-64
records.current_publisher_text_observed: Retrieved original Springer publisher HTML still displays 'piperacillin/clavulanic acid' as ninth drug in Abstract Methods (display lines 66-67), despite publisher banner 'updated' (lines 58-60). This may be a stale/cached representation; not independently verified as latest live Version of Record.
records.severity_provisional: S2 for intervention name in protocol abstract; possible S3 medication-identity risk only if unreconciled current article
records.estimator_signature: NOT_APPLICABLE to medication label and no outcomes recalculated
records.strongest_benign_alternative: Publisher rendering is an old cached/versioned HTML view despite an updated article/PDF; the correction is only an abstract drug-list typo and not evidence of actual trial allocation or administration of the wrong drug. Cross-check the latest publisher PDF/HTML and prospectively registered treatment list before resolution.
records.missing_sources: Current publisher VoR text independently fresh, corrected PDF source span and registry/protocol medication list. No claim about current published error until these are obtained.
records.conclusion: Complete notice credit; correction published; apparent current HTML conflict HOLD not new source-adjudicated error

learning_cases.historical: Abstract ninth drug name appears as piperacillin/clavulanic acid
learning_cases.benign: same medication list with amoxicillin/clavulanic acid in sixth position AND piperacillin/tazobactam ninth position should not be flagged
learning_cases.abstention: correction notice exists but current VoR span is stale or unauthenticated => HOLD, even if page says updated

records.publisher: Springer Nature / BMC Pharmacology and Toxicology
records.notice_body_locator: Correction body 'Incorrect'/'Correct' paragraphs, publisher web lines 68-81
records.change_locator: Original article > Methods > Risk of bias and certainty of evidence, first sentence
records.notice_attested_before: independent assessors initials A.B. and B.C.
records.notice_attested_after: independent assessors initials A.M. and B.Q.
records.current_publisher_text_observed: Retrieved current original publisher HTML Methods > Risk of bias and certainty of evidence uses A.M. and B.Q. exactly, and publisher links its 7 March 2025 correction
records.severity_provisional: S2 author/reviewer attribution, not proof RoB ratings changed
records.strongest_benign_alternative: Corrected assessor identities alter attribution only; not evidence that reported RoB ratings, clinical outcomes or meta-analysis models were wrong. Cannot infer changed quality assessments absent underlying reviewer files.

records.numeric_status: NO_FLAG for narrow internally sourced simple counts only; not validation of review extraction, raw event denominators or pooled outcomes

coordination.cross_shard_ownership_warning: The published campaign text states SHA256(canonical normalized DOI). Existing shard-02 and shard-05 credits demonstrably hash the bare DOI; a separate previously drafted shard-09 record reportedly uses 'doi:' + DOI, which assigns 3 of its 5 notice IDs to different workers under bare-DOI hash. Before aggregator publishes a total, agree one rule, migrate wrong-shard records with aliases, and deduplicate. This run hashes bare DOI, matching shard02/05 and the original proposed explicit SHA256(canonical DOI) examples.
coordination.require_human_confirmation_of_campaign_n: Owner hash mismatch is protocol ambiguity, NOT a discovered paper error

next_cursor: Continue new open-access journal correction notices after this batch; prioritize notices correcting event counts, denominators and published percentages; do not recount these two; coordinate hash normalization before aggregate.
